name: Round-Trip Translate
description: Rewrite text by translating it through a pivot language and back with Google Cloud Translation, after removing invisible Unicode characters. Requires your own Google Cloud Translation API key; the result can change meaning and should be reviewed.
tagline: Reword text through a translation round trip

config.description: Translate text with Google Cloud Translation (Basic, v2). Returns data.translations[].translatedText and, when source is omitted, detectedSourceLanguage. Requires a Google Cloud Translation API key in the plugin settings.

target.description: Target language code, for example en, de, or ja.

source.description: Source language code. Omit to let Google detect it.

config.description: Remove invisible Unicode characters (zero-width characters, byte-order marks, soft hyphens, bidirectional controls, tag characters) and replace unusual space characters with ordinary spaces. Returns the cleaned text and per-kind counts.

keep_joiners.description: Keep zero-width joiners and non-joiners, which emoji sequences and some scripts (Persian, Indic) need. Defaults to false.

fields.label: Google Cloud Translation API key
fields.description: An API key for a Google Cloud project with the Cloud Translation API enabled. Stored encrypted on this node and sent only to translation.googleapis.com.
